properties.name: title
properties.comment: The notification's title, at most 255 bytes of UTF-8 without NUL (std::invalid_argument otherwise); empty shows the text alone. Read by the next show. UI thread only (std::logic_error).
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("ToastNotification title must be UTF-8 without NUL of at most 255 bytes");

properties.name: text
properties.comment: The notification's text, at most 1023 bytes of UTF-8 without NUL (std::invalid_argument otherwise). show refuses empty text. Read by the next show. UI thread only (std::logic_error).
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("ToastNotification text must be UTF-8 without NUL of at most 1023 bytes");

properties.name: urgency
properties.comment: How much the notification asks for attention (HostDesktopNotificationUrgency): critical maps to the platform's insistent notification where it has one. Throws std::invalid_argument outside the enumeration. Read by the next show. UI thread only (std::logic_error).
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("ToastNotification urgency is outside HostDesktopNotificationUrgency");

properties.name: silent
properties.comment: Whether the platform is asked not to play its notification sound. Read by the next show. UI thread only (std::logic_error).

not_properties.name: status
not_properties.reason: the host's answer to the last request; read-only

not_properties.name: shown
not_properties.reason: whether the platform still lists the notification as live; read-only
